firmwareVersionNote: Not recorded at capture time, and now unrecoverable -- the device has since been updated twice. This omission is the defect that motivated ADR-0006's corpus-refresh requirement: a corpus whose firmware is unknown cannot support any argument about format drift. The content has since been confirmed current as of firmware 3.29.1.0; see verifications below.

integrity.aggregateScope: sha256 of the concatenated per-file sha256 digests of stock/*.template plus templates.json, filenames sorted; truncated to 32 hex chars
integrity.perFileHashesOmitted: Git already content-hashes every file in this snapshot, so duplicating per-file digests here would add maintenance burden with no benefit. The aggregate exists because it is a single value comparable across captures.

contents.stock/: The 65 templates reMarkable ships. All declare "author": "reMarkable".
contents.user/: The owner's 3 custom templates. All declare "author": "DAdent". Separated from stock because the original ADR-0006 measurements accidentally conflated the two.
contents.templates.json: The pristine stock manifest, with no user entries merged in. 79 entries for 65 files: a filename may appear twice, once per orientation.

verifications.trigger: firmware update applied; the update wiped the owner's custom templates and he re-applied them
verifications.firmwareVersionNote: Not captured. This is the release immediately preceding 3.29.1.0; a second update was already downloaded and awaiting reboot at the time of this capture, so the running firmware was the earlier one. Exact version unknown.
verifications.method: manual scp of /usr/share/remarkable/templates; the owner's custom templates were then removed and the saved-aside stock templates.json restored, to recover a pristine stock state for comparison

verifications.trigger: second firmware update installed and device rebooted
verifications.firmwareVersionNote: IMG_VERSION is the reMarkable release version. os-release VERSION_ID on this device is 6.0.112, which is the underlying Codex Linux (OpenEmbedded) version and NOT the firmware -- see the note in tools/Get-DeviceTemplateCorpus.ps1. /usr/share/remarkable/update.conf does not exist on this firmware.
verifications.method: manual scp of /usr/share/remarkable/templates captured BEFORE the owner re-applied his custom templates, so this capture was natively pristine: 65 stock templates, no user entries in the manifest

verificationSummary: The stock corpus is byte-identical across three firmware generations: the March 2026 capture, the release preceding 3.29.1.0, and 3.29.1.0 itself. Both updates wiped the owner's custom templates while leaving all 65 stock templates untouched -- the product's core use case (PRD 4.6), now observed rather than assumed. Because the content is identical, no duplicate snapshot directories were created; these verification records are the artefact instead.
